data.headline: Strategic Principal Engineer | Program Management Expert | Innovator in Advanced Technologies (Python, Computer Vision) | DevOps and Automation Specialist | Proven Track Record in Lean Practices | Python Coach
data.about: Innovative Principal Engineer with 15+ years of strategic leadership in software engineering, program management, and cutting-edge technologies. Recognized for superior problem-solving and critical thinking skills, I bring a meticulous approach to reviewing plans and implementing improvements. A Lean enthusiast and automation specialist, I've successfully led Lean Council, resulting in substantial savings and process enhancements. Proficient in Python, Computer Vision, and DevOps tools, I've mentored teams and championed advanced technologies for prototype development. My career spans impactful roles at Medtronic, Honeywell, Rockwell Collins and HCL, where I've excelled in streamlining processes, reducing cycle times, and enhancing product quality. Awards include Rookie of the Year at Medtronic and Outstanding Engineer at Honeywell. Eager to connect with professionals passionate about innovation, technology, and continuous improvement in the dynamic landscape of engineering and program management.
